trans-unit.source: These services process personal information to show you personalized or interest-based advertisements.

trans-unit.source: These services are essential for the correct functioning of this website. You cannot disable them here as the service would not work correctly otherwise.
trans-unit.target: Izi serivisi ni ngombwa kugira ngo uru rubuga rukore neza. Ntushobora kuzikuraho hano kuko bitabaye ibyo serivisi itakora neza.

trans-unit.source: These services process personal information to show you relevant content about products, services or topics that you might be interested in.
trans-unit.target: Izi serivisi zitunganya amakuru bwite kugira ngo zikwereke ibirimo bijyanye n’ibicuruzwa, serivisi cyangwa ingingo ushobora kuba ukunda.

trans-unit.source: These services process personal information to optimize the service that this website offers.
trans-unit.target: Izi serivisi zitunganya amakuru bwite kugira ngo zinoze serivisi uru rubuga rutanga.

trans-unit.source: Use this switch to enable or disable all services.
trans-unit.target: Koresha aka kabuto kugira ngo wemere cyangwa uhagarike serivisi zose.

trans-unit.source: This service is loaded by default (but you can opt out)
trans-unit.target: Iyi serivisi ifungurwa ku buryo mburabuzi (ariko ushobora kuyanga)

trans-unit.source: These services gather anonymous data for statistical analysis and performance optimization. Enabling analytics services assists website owners in making informed decisions to enhance online services.
trans-unit.target: Izi serivisi zegeranya amakuru atagaragaza umuntu kugira ngo hakorwe isesengura ry’imibare no kunoza imikorere. Kwemera serivisi z’isesengura bifasha ba nyiri imbuga gufata ibyemezo bishingiye ku makuru kugira ngo bateze imbere serivisi zo kuri internet.

trans-unit.source: Security services are crucial for safeguarding your online experience. These services help protect your data and privacy by detecting and preventing security threats, such as malware, phishing attempts, and unauthorized access. They ensure a safer browsing environment.
trans-unit.target: Serivisi z’umutekano ni ingenzi mu kurinda uko ukoresha internet. Izi serivisi zifasha kurinda amakuru yawe n’ibanga ryawe zimenya kandi zikabuza ibyago by’umutekano nka malware, uburiganya bwa phishing, n’ukwinjira kutemewe. Zituma habaho ahantu ho gusura internet hatekanye kurushaho.

trans-unit.source: Live chat services enable real-time communication with website support teams. They offer a convenient way to ask questions, seek assistance, or engage in discussions while browsing a website. Live chat enhances your online interaction and customer support experience.
trans-unit.target: Serivisi z’ikiganiro kizima zituma habaho itumanaho ryo ako kanya n’amatsinda ashinzwe gufasha ku rubuga. Zitanga uburyo bworoshye bwo kubaza ibibazo, gusaba ubufasha cyangwa kuganira mu gihe usura urubuga. Ikiganiro kizima cyongera imikoranire yawe yo kuri internet n’ubunararibonye bwo gufashwa nk’umukiriya.

trans-unit.source: Services related to styling help to improve the appearance of the website. This can also have an impact on usability.
trans-unit.target: Serivisi zijyanye no gutegura isura zifasha kunoza uko urubuga rugaragara. Ibi bishobora no kugira ingaruka ku buryo rukoreshwa.

trans-unit.source: Embedding videos from external platforms to enrich the content on this website.
trans-unit.target: Kwinjiza amavidewo avuye ku mbuga zo hanze kugira ngo ibiri kuri uru rubuga bikungahare.

trans-unit.source: Embedding social media from external platforms to enrich the content on this website.
trans-unit.target: Kwinjiza imbuga nkoranyambaga zivuye ku mbuga zo hanze kugira ngo ibiri kuri uru rubuga bikungahare.

trans-unit.source: This includes services that do not fall under the other purposes.
trans-unit.target: Ibi birimo serivisi zitari mu zindi ntego.

trans-unit.source: Adobe Fonts provides web fonts used for this website. When enabled, font files are loaded from Adobe and technical connection data may be processed.
trans-unit.target: Adobe Fonts itanga web fonts zikoreshwa kuri uru rubuga. Iyo yemerewe, amadosiye y’imyandikire akurwa kuri Adobe kandi amakuru ya tekiniki y’ihuza ashobora gutunganywa.

trans-unit.source: Google AdSense enables personalized ads on websites while respecting user privacy. By consenting, you allow relevant ads and help support free content.
trans-unit.target: Google AdSense ituma habaho amatangazo yamamaza yihariye ku mbuga kandi yubahiriza ibanga ry’umukoresha. Iyo ubyemeye, wemera amatangazo ajyanye n’ibikureba kandi ugafasha gushyigikira ibirimo bitishyurwa.

trans-unit.source: Consent to the use of surveillance camera images for security and safety purposes, in compliance with applicable data privacy regulations.
trans-unit.target: Kwemera ikoreshwa ry’amashusho ya kamera y’umutekano ku mpamvu z’umutekano no kurinda abantu, hakurikijwe amategeko agenga ibanga ry’amakuru akurikizwa.

trans-unit.source: Career Captain provides gamified career orientation and recruiting content. When enabled, external content from Career Captain may process usage and technical connection data.
trans-unit.target: Career Captain itanga ibirimo byo kuyobora abantu mu mwuga no gushaka abakozi mu buryo bw’imikino. Iyo yemerewe, ibirimo byo hanze biva kuri Career Captain bishobora gutunganya amakuru y’imikoreshereze n’amakuru ya tekiniki y’ihuza.

trans-unit.source: Microsoft Clarity is a user-friendly web analytics tool that empowers website visitors like you by providing transparency about how your interactions are tracked on a website. It ensures your privacy is respected while giving developers and website owners valuable insights into user behavior. Plus, it follows coding guidelines and best practices, ensuring a safe and secure online experience for you.
trans-unit.target: Microsoft Clarity ni igikoresho cya web analytics cyorohereza umukoresha, gitanga umucyo ku buryo ibikorwa byawe bikurikiranwa ku rubuga. Gikora ku buryo ibanga ryawe ryubahirizwa, kandi kigaha abateza imbere n’abanyiri imbuga amakuru y’ingirakamaro ku myitwarire y’abakoresha. Ikindi kandi gikurikiza coding guidelines na best practices kugira ngo uburambe bwawe kuri internet bube butekanye.

trans-unit.source: Cloudflare helps protect and optimize websites. By using this website, you consent to Cloudflare's data processing practices as described in its Privacy Policy.
trans-unit.target: Cloudflare ifasha kurinda no kunoza imbuga. Iyo ukoresha uru rubuga, uba wemeye uburyo Cloudflare itunganya amakuru nk’uko bisobanuwe muri Privacy Policy yayo.

trans-unit.source: Simplifies web tracking for analytics and marketing while ensuring data compliance and control.
trans-unit.target: Yoroshya web tracking ku isesengura no kwamamaza, kandi igafasha kubahiriza amategeko y’amakuru no kuyagenzura.

trans-unit.source: Fast Fonts, operated by fonts.com and supplied by fast.fonts.net, is a service for the provision of web fonts. It requires the use of a pixel-code for continuous price calculation.
trans-unit.target: Fast Fonts, ikoreshwa na fonts.com kandi itangwa na fast.fonts.net, ni serivisi yo gutanga web fonts. Isaba gukoresha pixel-code kugira ngo ibiciro bibazwe ku buryo bukomeza.

trans-unit.source: Google Ads allows advertisers to reach their target audience online. To personalize ads and measure their effectiveness, Google may collect data with your consent.
trans-unit.target: Google Ads ifasha abamamaza kugera ku bo bagamije kuri internet. Kugira ngo amatangazo ahuzwe n’abantu kandi hapimwe uko akora, Google ishobora gukusanya amakuru ubyemeye.

trans-unit.source: Web analytics service provided by Google, Inc. ("Google")
trans-unit.target: Serivisi ya web analytics itangwa na Google, Inc. ("Google")

trans-unit.source: Google Maps allows for the integration of interactive maps on websites, enabling location-based services. Developers can utilize it while ensuring data compliance and control, adhering to coding guidelines and best practices.
trans-unit.target: Google Maps ituma hashyirwa amakarita akorana ku mbuga, igafasha serivisi zishingiye ku hantu. Abateza imbere bashobora kuyikoresha mu gihe hubahirizwa amategeko y’amakuru no kuyagenzura, kandi hakurikizwa coding guidelines na best practices.

trans-unit.source: Google Tag Manager streamlines web tracking and code management, ensuring data compliance and control for developers.
trans-unit.target: Google Tag Manager yoroshya web tracking no gucunga code, igafasha abateza imbere kubahiriza amategeko y’amakuru no kuyagenzura.

trans-unit.source: Allows Instagram posts to be embedded. Personal data may be transferred to Instagram (Meta Platforms) in the process.
trans-unit.target: Yemerera kwinjiza posts za Instagram. Muri icyo gikorwa, amakuru bwite ashobora koherezwa kuri Instagram (Meta Platforms).

trans-unit.source: Chat widget and collecting of visitor statistics
trans-unit.target: Widget y’ikiganiro no gukusanya imibare y’abasura

trans-unit.source: Klaro! manages consent choices for this website and stores whether individual services may be loaded according to your preferences.
trans-unit.target: Klaro! icunga amahitamo y’ubwumvikane kuri uru rubuga kandi ikabika niba serivisi imwe ku yindi ishobora gufungurwa hakurikijwe ibyo wahisemo.

trans-unit.source: Open source software for statistical analysis of visitor accesses
trans-unit.target: Porogaramu ya open source yo gusesengura imibare y’uko abasura binjira

trans-unit.source: Real-time user analytics service that helps to understand how visitors interact with our website.
trans-unit.target: Serivisi y’isesengura ry’abakoresha mu gihe nyacyo ifasha kumva uko abasura bakorana n’urubuga rwacu.

trans-unit.source: SalesViewer analyzes website visits for B2B lead generation and may identify company-related visitor information based on usage and technical access data.
trans-unit.target: SalesViewer isesengura gusura urubuga hagamijwe B2B lead generation kandi ishobora kumenya amakuru y’umusura ajyanye n’isosiyete hashingiwe ku makuru y’imikoreshereze n’ay’ukwinjira kwa tekiniki.

trans-unit.source: Allows TikTok videos to be embedded. Personal data may be transferred to TikTok and processed in third countries.
trans-unit.target: Yemerera kwinjiza amavidewo ya TikTok. Amakuru bwite ashobora koherezwa kuri TikTok no gutunganyirizwa mu bihugu bya gatatu.

trans-unit.source: X (formerly Twitter) is a social media platform that allows users to share and interact with short messages and multimedia content. Developers can integrate Twitter features into websites to enhance user engagement and real-time updates while maintaining data privacy compliance and adhering to coding guidelines.
trans-unit.target: X (yahoze ari Twitter) ni urubuga nkoranyambaga rutuma abakoresha basangiza abandi kandi bagakorana n’ubutumwa bugufi n’ibirimo bya multimedia. Abateza imbere bashobora kwinjiza ibiranga Twitter mu mbuga kugira ngo bongere uruhare rw’abakoresha n’amakuru agezweho mu gihe nyacyo, bubahiriza ibanga ry’amakuru na coding guidelines.

trans-unit.source: Userlike offers a live chat solution that enhances user interactions on websites.
trans-unit.target: Userlike itanga igisubizo cya live chat cyongera imikoranire y’abakoresha ku mbuga.

trans-unit.source: Popular video-sharing platform that offers a range of features for creators and developers to enhance video content on websites.
trans-unit.target: Urubuga ruzwi rwo gusangira amavidewo rutanga ibiranga bitandukanye ku bakora ibirimo n’abateza imbere kugira ngo banoze ibirimo bya videwo ku mbuga.

trans-unit.source: The leading video-sharing platform for content creators and developers to enhance user experiences on websites.
trans-unit.target: Urubuga ruyoboye mu gusangira amavidewo, rukoreshwa n’abakora ibirimo n’abateza imbere kugira ngo bongere uburambe bw’abakoresha ku mbuga.
